headline: Democrats criticize Trump over Nvidia case
summary: Democrats accused Trump of compromising US security and seeking personal gain by pressing for Jensen Huang to return to lead chipmaker Nvidia. The criticism concerns Trump's involvement in the company's leadership.
why: Nvidia is the leading designer of AI accelerator chips, and its leadership and US policy ties are closely watched by investors.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: The political dispute concerns who leads Nvidia, which affects governance and strategic perception of the company.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

original_headline: Demócratas critican a Trump por caso Nvidia
